answer: Each new agent locks a 50 POA escrow before bidding on work, and every epoch a random vertex in the task graph is chosen to blind re-run a peer's output. A failed audit burns the escrow. A forger can sign endless identities with one quill, but each fake needs its own deposit, and audits compare sibling outputs: ten clones answering alike get flagged together, so the attacker stakes 500 POA and can lose it all at once. No ivory-tower curator required; randomness polices.
